critique: Impeccable fidelity to the reference product geometry, typography, and dial layout. The vertical rectangular monolith housing, 9 upper radial ticks (with a completely blank bottom arc), accurate beach labels, lower sub-dial, and burnt-orange hands are all spot-on. The Mediterranean architectural setting with white Carrara and deep Rosso Levanto marble plinths alongside dappled olive tree shadows delivers a stunning Domus/Architectural Digest editorial aesthetic.
